memories.title: Our Wedding Day
memories.descriptionForKai: This was David and Maria's wedding day in the spring of 1978 under the grand oak tree at Rosewood Gardens. Maria wore a lace gown with wildflowers, and David could not stop smiling.
memories.imageToGenerate: A warm, slightly faded color photograph from the 1970s of a happy couple in wedding attire, smiling under a large oak tree.

memories.title: Sarah's First Bike Ride
memories.descriptionForKai: This was the special sunny afternoon when David taught his daughter Sarah how to ride her little red bicycle at Pine Lake Park. She was so proud when he let go of the seat.
memories.imageToGenerate: A sunny, candid photo from the 1980s of a father running proudly beside his young daughter on a small red bicycle with training wheels.

memories.title: Bringing Buddy Home
memories.descriptionForKai: This is the day the family brought Buddy home as an 8-week-old golden retriever puppy. He fell fast asleep in David's lap on the drive back from the farm.
memories.imageToGenerate: A close-up, heartwarming photo of a small, fluffy golden retriever puppy sleeping peacefully in a person's lap.

memories.title: Summer Garden Harvest
memories.descriptionForKai: David loved tending to his heirloom tomatoes and sweet basil every July. The whole kitchen would smell like fresh summer herbs and homemade marinara sauce.
memories.imageToGenerate: A warm sunlit garden with red ripe tomatoes on the vine and fresh green herbs in wooden baskets.
